player_decisions.decision: Choose which carried item to equip, move, inspect, or discard.
player_decisions.required_information: Item identity, comparison, slot compatibility, quantity, ownership, and action consequence.

player_decisions.decision: Confirm or cancel an irreversible discard.
player_decisions.required_information: Exact item, quantity, loss consequence, and safe cancel path.

screens.decision: Browse carried items and select a safe next action.
screens.entry: Open inventory from gameplay or resume the previous inventory focus after closing an item detail.
screens.exit: Back returns to gameplay when no modal is active; selecting an item opens details as an overlay.
screens.back_behavior: Close the topmost overlay first, otherwise resume gameplay without changing inventory state.
screens.initial_focus: Restore the last valid item; if unavailable, focus the first enabled category or the empty-state action.

screens.decision: Compare the selected item and choose equip, move, inspect, or discard.
screens.entry: Open from a valid inventory item and retain the background list position.
screens.exit: Back restores focus to the originating item or the nearest valid replacement.
screens.back_behavior: Dismiss the overlay without applying an action.
screens.initial_focus: Focus the primary enabled action, or the restriction explanation when no action is enabled.

screens.decision: Confirm or cancel irreversible item loss.
screens.entry: Open only from the discard action with the exact item and quantity in the prompt.
screens.exit: Cancel returns to item detail; success returns to the updated list; error preserves a recoverable choice.
screens.back_behavior: Back always cancels while no submission is in flight and never confirms.
screens.initial_focus: Focus the safe cancel action unless current platform guidance requires a different documented pattern.

focus_order: screen title and status when announced
navigation.device_switch: When the active device changes, preserve the selected item; show focus only for focus-driven input and update prompt glyphs without moving the selection.
navigation.modal_behavior: Contain focus in the confirmation modal, block gameplay actions, and restore focus to the invoking discard control on cancel.
navigation.destructive_behavior: Back never confirms, item and quantity are named, and stale server state prevents the action with a recoverable explanation.

layout.safe_area: Constrain actionable content and critical text to the runtime-reported safe region while allowing decorative background to extend outside it.
anchors: screen title and back affordance remain in the safe top region
item collection owns the main expandable region
action area stays adjacent to the selected item when space allows and reflows below it when constrained
layout.text_scaling: Controls expand or reflow with the product UI/text scale and do not clip required labels or focus outlines.
layout.reflow: At constrained width or expanded text, convert the side detail panel into a stacked overlay while preserving selection and action order.
layout.scrolling: The collection and detail content have separate explicit scroll ownership; focus movement scrolls the relevant control into view.

localization.externalized: All player-visible labels, item descriptions, quantities, prompts, and error messages are externalized.
localization.expansion: Buttons and panels support content expansion through wrapping, flexible containers, and reviewed truncation only for non-critical reference text.
localization.bidirectional: Logical start/end layout and focus order are reviewed with representative right-to-left content.
localization.fonts: Fallback fonts cover required scripts and symbols without changing semantic emphasis.
localization.input_glyphs: Prompts use the active device mapping and expose a readable text alternative.

signals: selection and item rarity do not rely on color alone
disabled actions expose a safe explanation
focus remains visible against every item background
status and error changes have persistent visual text and an announcement path where supported
accessibility.settings_entry: Accessibility and input settings are reachable before gameplay and through the pause menu with every declared focus-driven input.
accessibility.motion: Inventory transitions respect reduced-motion settings and do not remove state-change confirmation.
accessibility.media_alternatives: Item audio previews, if present, have a visual state and stop control; no decision depends on audio or haptics alone.

data_bindings.initial_state: Show loading until the first authorized snapshot or an explicit offline/error state arrives.
data_bindings.update: Apply item-added, item-changed, item-removed, and reconnect snapshot events.
data_bindings.stale: Mark actions unavailable and request a fresh snapshot after reconnect or version conflict.
data_bindings.error: Preserve recoverable context and show a specific retry or exit path.
data_bindings.permission: Never bind another player's private inventory or server-only validation data.

data_bindings.source: selected authorized item plus server action result
data_bindings.initial_state: Render the exact current item and quantity from the selected snapshot.
data_bindings.update: Disable duplicate submission and reconcile success, rejection, or stale-item response.
data_bindings.stale: Cancel the pending action if the item changed and explain what must be reselected.
data_bindings.error: Return to a safe actionable state without implying that discard succeeded.
data_bindings.permission: The server validates ownership and quantity for every discard action.

matrix.locale: Korean with expanded UI text scale
matrix.expected: All items and actions are reachable with visible focus; prompts match the controller; back restores focus; text and critical signals do not clip.
The stale action cannot confirm, the explanation persists, device switching preserves the item context, and back takes the safe cancel path.
Logical layout, safe area, text reflow, retry/exit actions, and scroll ownership remain understandable and operable.

acceptance: Every declared screen state has a reachable and escapable interaction path.
Focus and selection survive permitted layout, locale, scale, and device changes.
Critical information uses redundant signals and remains inside the measured safe region.
Stale, error, and unauthorized data never appear as successful current state.
verification.evidence: Record build, device or viewport, input, locale, scale, accessibility settings, screen capture, and event/state trace for each required matrix row.

decisions.decision: Use one responsive inventory flow rather than separate controller and touch screens.
decisions.basis: The player decisions and data states are shared; input, focus visibility, prompts, and layout can vary within one explicit contract.

route_out.next_owner: engine UI implementation and accessibility verification
route_out.reason: The generic interaction contract is frozen; concrete widgets, visuals, events, and runtime captures belong to the selected engine and product owners.
